ruleDefinitions.name: System Network Discovery - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects enumeration of local network configuration

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/firewall\\-cmd$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ufw$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/iptables$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/netstat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ss$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ip$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ifconfig$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/systemd\\-resolve$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/route$")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/resolv\\\.conf.*"))
